notes.title: Something Like a Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello,
Thank you for playing "Axiom of Maria: Prologue." There have been frequent questions about the sequel, so I've put together a brief roadmap.
"Axiom of Maria" was inspired by an old TV series called A Team. I wanted to depict a story where the few remaining people in a seemingly hopeless future casually banter. Initially, I considered making three to five chapters.
The prologue you played is a prequel to the main chapters, and I'm currently preparing the first chapter. The playtime of the first chapter will be similar to or slightly longer than the prologue, and I aim to complete it by the end of next year. Based on the feedback from the prologue, I have improved the controls, UI, and level design, and I'm particularly striving to properly incorporate metroidvania elements that couldn't be fully implemented in the prologue.
I would like to include a different form of bike combat at the end of the game, but this may change depending on the development circumstances. It seems more likely to be completed as a standalone game rather than DLC.
Thank you once again.

notes.title: 0.20.230915 Release
notes.notes:
I've remade many parts since the prototype.

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added five stages: Underground Parking Backroom, Underground Tunnel, Ex-Wedding Museum Unprotected Area, Mother's Room, and Physical Document Storage. Playtime has increased from 40 minutes to 4 hours.
[*] Added one boss and one type of regular enemy. Model 3A, a boss using a responsive sword similar to the player, and a bot using a shield as a regular enemy have been added.
[*] Suit Program System. As the game progresses, expand the memory with the obtained Imago, and with the expanded memory, install the Suit Program acquired during gameplay to add and use new functions to the suit.
[*] Time Attack mode added. After clearing the story, play Time Attack to finish the game within a limited time, without any story or events. Scores are calculated based on the remaining time and the number of passed checkpoints. Time decreases when attacked by enemies.
[*] Achievements added.
[*] Steam Deck support. In the graphic settings option, select Steam Deck for a smooth gameplay experience on Steam Deck.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Story overhaul. Many parts of the story have been reworked. New Korean and English voice recordings have been made for the new story. The new story supports Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese texts.
[*] Action rework. Attack animations have been replaced. Improved controls.
[*] Bike Action modifications. Improved controls and fixed bugs.
[*] Enhanced graphic quality and performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.12.230803 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. I have been updating the development log, and now it seems like I am ready for a build update. I have almost recreated everything. I wanted to update with English voice-over, but the English recording is taking longer than I expected, so I am first updating with the Korean voice-over version.

The following modifications have been made:

[list]
[*] Most elements, except for modeling, have been reworked.
[*] The story has been reworked.
[*] Five additional stages have been added, extending the gameplay time to around 3-4 hours.
[*] One boss and one new enemy have been added, resulting in a total of seven enemy types.
[*] Graphics and performance have been improved (currently in testing).
[*] Challenge objectives have been implemented.
[*] A perk system has been added.
[/list]

This version supports text in Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese, with voice-over in Korean. I will update it with the English voice-over as soon as it's completed. Japanese and Chinese voice-overs will be recorded later. The costs turned out to be higher than I anticipated.

The official testing will commence once the English voice-over is incorporated, and once the testing phase is complete, the demo will be released.

notes.title: DevLog 20230729
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=pkRpZaZenEk;full][/previewyoutube]
I'm continuing with the English voice recording. In the meantime, I'm making a new piece of music and the first trailer. The first trailer, which includes English and Korean voices, is expected to be released around the start of the test.

notes.title: DevLog 20230722
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=b7k5CGdSaY4;full][/previewyoutube]
While recording English voiceovers, I'm making build adjustments based on new feedback from the playability test and preparing materials. I'm also setting up a website for test announcements. The test version will support Korean, English, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), and Japanese text, as well as Korean and English voices. I'd like to offer Chinese and Japanese voices at launch, but the recording cost is not insignificant. I want to finish recording English voices, start testing, release the game, and begin working on the next chapter as soon as possible. Once testing begins, I plan to keep the Early Access build in sync with the test build.

notes.title: DevLog 20230715
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=tpcfcDpUA9U;full][/previewyoutube]
The review of the translation is all done, and it seems I'll soon start recording the English voice-over. However, working across the sea feels like communicating through carrier pigeons or beacon fires. I didn't realize it when someone was managing in the middle. I wanted to update you on the status of "Axiom of Maria." The build is still in playtest, and I am working on fixing bugs and improving the gameplay.

Once these tasks are complete, I will outsource a translation and record the voiceover. During this time, I will also create achievements, prepare materials, and update the homepage and Steam page. After the voiceover work, I will run a QA check to identify and fix any remaining bugs.

My rough estimate for updating the Early Access version of "Axiom of Maria" is around June with the QA build. However, as a solo developer, I am doing my best, but I cannot make the process faster. I appreciate your patience with this project and your interest in it.

Thank you so much for your support.
